_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY — fictional entries. This repository is PUBLIC, and a maintained
list of real participant names is exactly the Class P material the extraction
gate exists to keep out of public reach. Do not populate this file.
The real roster lives in a private repo (podzoneTeam) and is passed to the
scanner by path: --roster <path>, or the EXTRACTION_ROSTER environment variable.
With no roster configured the tier-3 participant-name check does not run, and
the scanner says so in its summary rather than passing silently.
Roster entries are only ever compared against added lines, and only at B1/B3/B4
— participant attribution is permitted at B2 (gate §2.1).
